halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.description: Feleletsa thomo ya letsholo kgotsa motshameko wa batshameki ba le bantsi.
halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Your Journey Begins" mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go wetsa ka botlalo thomo epe ya letsholo kgotsa motshameko wa batshameki ba le bantsi.

halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.description: Bolaya baba ba le 100 kgotsa batshameki.
halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Just Getting Started" mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go bolaya palogotlhe ya baba ba le 100 kgotsa batshameki mo thomong epe ya letsholo kgotsa mo motshamekong wa batshameki ba le bantsi.

halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Batla mosaeno wa bobedi o o fitlhegileng.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "I’m Sorry, Dave" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka go batla lee le le rileng la paseka le le tlotlang David Candland, mokaedi wa UI wa motshameko. Kaelo e e feletseng ya gore o ka e bona jang ke eno:

1. Simolola thomo epe ya letsholo kgotsa mmapa wa batshameki ba le bantsi mo Halo: Reach.
2. Tsaya sebetsa se **se se nang** le ntlha ya sekopo sa go atolosa. Dikai tse di tlwaelegileng di akaretsa Sethunya sa go Tlhasela kgotsa Sethunya sa Plasma.
3. Tobetsa konopo ya zoom (gantsi thupa e e siameng mo dikhonsoleng kgotsa konopo e e tlhomilweng mo PC) go "zoom in" ka sebetsa sa gago se se sa scoped.
4. Leba sentle **sekhutlo se se kwa tlase sa molema** sa sekerini sa gago. O tla lemoga mogala wa khoutu ya binary o tlhagelela ka bokhutshwane.
5. Khoutu eno ya bobedi e ranolelwa mo lefokong "Dave" mo kemeding ya bobedi ya ASCII.

Ka go latela dikgato tseno le go ela tlhoko khoutu ya binary, o tla lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "I’m Sorry, Dave".

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Balaho’s Most Wanted" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla tlhoka go fedisa palogotlhe e e kopantsweng ya Di-Grunt di le 100 mo mokgweng wa PVE, o o akaretsang Letsholo, Ntwa ya Molelo, le Spartan Ops. Ka lesego, phitlhelelo eno e ka lotlololwa bonolo ka go tshameka ka tlwaelo.

halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.description: Fetsa dithomo di le 10 kgotsa metshameko ya batshameki ba le bantsi.
halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Where Am I?" mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go wetsa ka botlalo palogotlhe ya dithomo tsa letsholo di le 10 kgotsa metshameko e le 10 ya batshameki ba le bantsi.

halomcc-the-one-percent-088630ade1.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "The One Percent" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla tlhoka go fedisa palogotlhe e e kopantsweng ya Di-Elite di le 100 mo mokgweng wa PVE, o o akaretsang Letsholo, Ntwa ya Molelo, le Spartan Ops. Ka lesego, phitlhelelo eno e ka lotlololwa bonolo ka go tshameka ka tlwaelo.

halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.description: Halo: Reach: Tshoganyetso e e Feletseng ya Mariga.
halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "We're Just Getting Started" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Winter Contingency" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-spoilsport-3dada00509.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Spoilsport" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla tlhoka go fedisa palogotlhe e e kopantsweng ya Di-Jacal di le 100 mo mokgweng wa PVE, o o akaretsang Letsholo, Ntwa ya Molelo, le Spartan Ops. Ka lesego, phitlhelelo eno e ka lotlololwa bonolo ka go tshameka ka tlwaelo.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.description: Bokella dimmentlele tsa letsholo la 500 kapa tsa lenane la dipina.
halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Just A Taste" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla tlhoka go kokoanya dimmentlele di le 500 tsa letsholo kgotsa tsa lenaane la dipina. Dimmentlele tseno di ka bonwa fa o ntse o tshameka letsholo kgotsa o tsaya karolo mo go batleng balekane. Go oketsa kgatelopele ya gago, tlhoma mogopolo mo go bolayeng baba ka bonako le ka tsela e e nang le matswela, o ikaeletse go bona dimmentlele tsa dipolao tse dintsi le tsa go bolaya. Go tshameka ka bothata jo bo bonolo mo letsholong go a kgothalediwa, ka gonne go go letla go kokoanya dimmentlele kwantle ga kgwetlho e e oketsegileng ya mathata a a kwa godimo.

halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.description: Halo: Reach: ONI e e feletseng: Motheo wa Tšhaka.
halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Protocol Dictates Action" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Protocol Dictates Action" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Tshameka motshameko wa batshameki ba le bantsi kgotsa wa tirisanommogo bonnye dikgwedi di le 3 morago ga motshameko wa gago wa ntlha.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Stick With It...A Little Longer" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka motshameko wa batshameki ba le bantsi kgotsa wa tirisanommogo bonnye dikgwedi di le 3 morago ga gore o tshameke motshameko wa gago wa ntlha.

Go farologana le diphitlhelelo tse dingwe, eno ga e ka ke ya lotlololwa ka go dirisa letlha la tsamaiso ya gago, ka gonne e netefadiwa ke sefara.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.description: Halo CE: Feleletsa Pilara ya Letlhafula.
halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Pillar of Autumn" mo Halo: CE mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Pillar of Autumn" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
Phitlhelelo ya "The Guardians Are Coming" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) e ka lotlololwa ka go kopana le phelelo e e sa tlwaelegang: go bolawa ka tsela e e tlhakanyang tlhogo enjene ya motshameko. Fa seno se direga, motshameko gantsi o bontsha molaetsa o o reng, "You were killed by The Guardians." Mokgwa o o tlhamaletseng wa go bona phitlhelelo eno ke ono:

1. Mo menyung o mogolo wa Halo MCC, tlhopha letsholo la Halo 2.
2. Eya go tlhopha thomo.
3. Seta legata la scarab jaaka le le dirang.
4. Laisa thomo ya ntlha kgotsa thomo epe e nngwe e o e ratang.
5. Tshameka go fitlha o bona sebetsa.
6. Thunya fa fatshe.
7. Phitlhelelo e lotlolotswe!

Fa o latela dikgato tseno, o tla nna le "The Guardians Are Coming" mo kokoanyong ya gago.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Lwa mmogo le Chips Dubbo mme o reetse mafoko a gagwe a botlhale.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Go bona phitlhelelo ya "My Buddy Chips" mo Halo: Combat Evolved mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection, o tlhoka go kopana le moanelwa Chips Dubbo ka nako ya letsholo la Halo: Combat Evolved. O ka fumanwa dithomong tse fapaneng, empa batshameki ba bangata ba bile le katleho thomong ya "The Pillar of Autumn.".

Boloka masole a gago a lewatle a tshela, segolobogolo ka nako ya karolo e mabotho a Kgolagano a palamang sekepe sa gago mo go yone, mme o reetse puisano e e tlhaolang ya ga Dubbo. Phitlhelelo e tshwanetse go lotlololwa morago ga kopano e.

Go botlhokwa go ela tlhoko gore ponagalo ya ga Chips Dubbo e ka nna e e sa rulaganngwang, mme fa o na le bothata jwa go mo bona, leka go tshameka gape thomo mme o e tseye ka iketlo, o netefatse gore o nna le masole a gago a lewatle le go reetsa dipuisano tsotlhe tsa bone1.

halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.description: Halo: Reach: Bosigo jo bo Feletseng.
halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "I Need A Weapon" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Nightfall" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.description: Bolaya motlhabolodi wa 343 mo go batleng balekane kgotsa motho yo o nang le phitlhelelo eno.
halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Bite The Hand" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), mola wa go tshwantshanya batshameki ba le bantsi le go bolaya baganetsi ka nako ya metshameko e e tlwaelegileng. Sepheo e ka ba mohlahisi kapa sebapadi sefe kapa sefe se seng se na le phihlello ena, kahoo tswela pele ho bapala ho fihlela o fumana polao e tshwanelehang. Bidio e bontsha mofuta wa ntlha wa Halo 4 wa phitlhelelo, o o dirisang setlhotlheletsi se se tshwanang sa go nyalanya.

halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.description: Halo: Reach: Ela tlhoko letshwao la khamphani ya meepo e e konopiwang.
halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Mind the Skill Gap" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), mo Ntlheng ya Lerumo, batla letshwao la BXR Mining kwa lefelong la meepo. Ema fa o nang le pono e e tlhapileng mme o lebe ka tlhamalalo letshwao la khamphani go tlhotlheletsa phitlhelelo.

halomcc-all-out-of-bubblegum-22bdb2c4d2.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "All Out of Bubblegum" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla tlhoka go kokoanya dimmentlele di le 1000 tsa letsholo kgotsa tsa lenaane la dipina. halomcc-to-war-5b5e005c5c.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "To War" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Tip of the Spear" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-halo-6ecaacfb1e.description: Halo CE: Halo e e feletseng.
halomcc-halo-6ecaacfb1e.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Halo" mo Halo: Combat Evolved mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Halo" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.description: Feleletsa maemo ape a co-op mo bothateng jo bo tlwaelegileng.
halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.guideDescription:
Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Standard Operating Brocedure" mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go wetsa maemo ape fela a tirisanommogo mo bothateng jo bo Tlwaelegileng.

O ka boela wa fumana phihlello ya "Standard Operating Brocedure" ka ho bapala ka bothata ba Heroic kapa Legendary.

halomcc-going-bananas-a3478a4999.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Going Bananas" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fedisa Ditlhogo di le 100. Tshameka gape kopano ya Halo 3 kgotsa Halo 3: ODST e e nang le mmaba yono. Tswelela o tlosa baba ba ba tshwanelegang fa o ntse o bereka ka diphitlhelelo tse dingwe.

halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.description: Halo: Reach: Bosigo jo Boleele jo bo Feletseng jwa Kgomotso.
halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "You Flew Pretty Good" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Long Night of Solace" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.description: Halo CE: Feleletsa Boammaaruri le Poelano.
halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Truth and Reconciliation" mo Halo: Combat Evolved mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Truth and Reconciliation" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-delicious-brains-a0b4eb557d.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Delicious Brains" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fedisa 100 Morwalela. Tshameka gape thomo ya letsholo le le bokete la Morwalela jaaka The Library. Tswelela o tlosa baba ba ba tshwanelegang fa o ntse o bereka ka diphitlhelelo tse dingwe.

halomcc-into-the-howling-dark-faf89601ca.description: Halo: Reach: Ekesodo e e feletseng.
halomcc-into-the-howling-dark-faf89601ca.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "Into The Howling Dark" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tlhoka fela go tshameka ka thomo ya "Exodus" go tswa kwa tshimologong go ya kwa bokhutlong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe.

halomcc-gruntageddon-bbcb54f8fb.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Gruntageddon" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fedisa Di-Grunts di le 1000. Tshameka gape thomo ya letsholo le le bokete jwa Kgolagano fa mmaba a tlhagelelang ka ditlhopha. Tswelela o tlosa baba ba ba tshwanelegang fa o ntse o bereka ka diphitlhelelo tse dingwe.

halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Front Page News" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), mpatle mo tlelapong. Dirisa bidio go lemoga letshwao la naga le tsela e o ka atamelang ka yone. Fa e le gore ke selo, atamela gaufi thata gore o kgone go dirisana le sone pele ga o tswelela mo lefelong leo.

halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.description: Halo: Reach: Alekesanderia e Ntšha e e Feletseng.
halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Dust And Echoes" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), laisa New Alexandria go tswa kwa tshimologong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe mme o tshameke go fitlha kwa mokgeleng wa bofelo. Latela ditshwai tsa thomo mme o fetse maemo gore go tlhapiwe go kwalwe mo Tlhophong ya Thomo.

halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.description: Halo CE: Feleletsa Mokwadi wa Dikhato yo o Didimetseng.
halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "The Silent Cartographer" mo Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), laisa Mokwadi wa Dikhato yo o Didimetseng go tswa kwa tshimologong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe mme o tshameke go fitlha kwa maikaelelong a bofelo. Fitlhelela seteišene sa tshireletso pele go bula lefelo, o bo o fologela kwa Cartographer.

halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.description: Halo: Reach: Batla le go fedisa nngwe ya di-Elite tsa Molaodi wa Ranger tse di fitlhegileng.
halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "What About Bob?" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), batla le go fedisa nngwe ya Di-Elite tsa Molaodi wa Ranger tse di fitlhegileng. Dirisa bidio go lemoga letshwao la naga le tsela e o ka atamelang ka yone. Fa e le gore ke selo, atamela gaufi thata gore o kgone go dirisana le sone pele ga o tswelela mo lefelong leo.

halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.description: Halo: Reach: Phitlhelela dipuisano tsa radio tsa UNSC tse di fitlhegileng.
halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Easy to Overlook" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fitlhelela puisano e e fitlhegileng ya radio ya UNSC. Simolola go tswa mo lefelong le le bontshitsweng mo bidiong mme o latele thulaganyo ya lone pele o leka tiro.

halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.description: Halo: Reach: Bolaya Motlhoafaledi wa Elite pele a ka tshaba ka nako ya Ntlha ya Lerumo.
halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Your Heresy Will Stay Your Feet" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), bolaya Motlhoafaledi wa Elite pele a ka tshaba ka nako ya Ntlha ya Lerumo. Dirisa sebetsa se se tshwanang, koloi kgotsa boemo jo bo bontshiwang mo bidiong. Fa mokgele o tlhoka go itewa go go rileng ga bofelo, emisa go dira tshenyo e nngwe fa mokgele o setse o le bokoa.

halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.description: Halo 2: Lwa mmogo le Chips Dubbo wa tlwaelo mme o reetse mafoko a gagwe.
halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "THE Chips Dubbo?" mo Halo 2: Anniversary mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), tshameka Outskirts mme o nne gaufi le Marines fa o ntse o lwa ka dikopano tsa go simolola. Boloka Marine e e buang Se-Australia e tshela mme e le gaufi go fitlha o utlwa Chips Dubbo a bua. Fa a ka swa pele ga o mo utlwa, simolola gape go tswa kwa lefelong la go tlhola le le bulegang.

halomcc-game-on-7965c0c072.description: Feleletsa dithomo di le 50 kgotsa metshameko ya batshameki ba le bantsi.
halomcc-game-on-7965c0c072.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Game On" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fetsa palogotlhe e e kopantsweng ya dithomo tsa letsholo di le 50 kgotsa metshameko ya batshameki ba le bantsi. O ka refosana fa gare ga tsone. Tshameka gape dithomelo tse dikhutshwane tsa letsholo kgotsa nna mo go nyalaneng ka dipholo gore go fediwe gongwe le gongwe go kwalwe.

halomcc-can-t-keep-him-down-21a41e0ec7.description: Halo 3: Lwa mmogo le reetse The Man. Tlhamane. Ditšhipisi tsa Dubbo.
halomcc-can-t-keep-him-down-21a41e0ec7.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Can't Keep Him Down" mo Halo 3 mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), tshameka kopano ya Halo 3 le Masole a Lewatle mme o nne gaufi le Masole a Lewatle a a buang Se-Australia fa o ntse o tswelela pele. Mo boloke a tshela mme o mo neye nako ya go bua ka nako ya ntwa kgotsa morago ga yone.

halomcc-this-is-not-your-grave-2625dc7b4.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "This Is Not Your Grave" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), laisa Sephuthelwana go tswa kwa tshimologong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe mme o tshameke go fitlha kwa maikaelelong a bofelo. Latela ditshwai tsa thomo mme o fetse maemo gore go tlhapiwe go kwalwe mo Tlhophong ya Thomo.

halomcc-brovershield-0ccc5f822c.description: Feleletsa maemo ape a co-op mo bothateng jwa Heroic.
halomcc-brovershield-0ccc5f822c.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Brovershield" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), laletsa molekane mo lefelong la gago la go amogela Letsholo, tlhopha thomo e khutshwane e o e itseng sentle, mme o beye bothata go Heroic. Dula mo setlhopheng sa molelo mme lo fetse thomo mmogo. Bitsa matshosetsi mme o nne sekgala se se lekaneng go tila go fologa mmogo.

halomcc-send-me-out-with-a-bang-3c497f2e.description: Halo: Reach: Feleletsa Pilara ya Letlhafula.
halomcc-send-me-out-with-a-bang-3c497f2e.guideDescription: Go lotlolola "Send Me Out... With A Bang" mo Halo: Reach mo teng ga Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), laisa Pilara ya Letlhafula go tswa kwa tshimologong mo bothateng bongwe le bongwe mme o tshameke go fitlha kwa maikaelelong a bofelo. Latela ditshwai tsa thomo mme o fetse maemo gore go tlhapiwe go kwalwe mo Tlhophong ya Thomo.

halomcc-a-pile-of-medals-f80eff0712.description: Kgobokanya dimmentlele tsa letsholo kgotsa tsa lenaane la dipina di le 2 000.
halomcc-a-pile-of-medals-f80eff0712.guideDescription: Go lotlolola phitlhelelo ya "A Pile of Medals" mo Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla tlhoka go kokoanya dimmentlele tsa letsholo kgotsa tsa lenaane la dipina di le 2000. Dimmentlele tseno di ka bonwa fa o ntse o tshameka letsholo kgotsa o tsaya karolo mo go batleng balekane. Go oketsa kgatelopele ya gago, tlhoma mogopolo mo go bolayeng baba ka bonako le ka tsela e e nang le matswela, o ikaeletse go bona dimmentlele tsa dipolao tse dintsi le tsa go bolaya. Go tshameka ka bothata jo bo bonolo mo letsholong go a kgothalediwa, ka gonne go go letla go kokoanya dimmentlele kwantle ga kgwetlho e e oketsegileng ya mathata a a kwa godimo.
